title: _task
description: A unit of work. A parent task is created by a person or a skill and follows a _process; the engine creates its subtasks from that process. A subtask has a parent. Draft v0.

type.description: Task type; values are defined at project level.

status.description: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS or DONE. For a subtask: OPEN while it waits for its turn (a `dependOn` is not DONE yet, or it has not started), IN_PROGRESS once the engine starts it, DONE when its work is finished. For a parent task: set by the engine from its subtasks.

assignee.description: A role, not an agent. For a subtask, the role of its entry in the process. For a parent task, set when the approval is given to a bot role.

approvedBy.description: Parent task only. Must be one of `canApprovedBy`.

rejectedAt.description: Parent task only. A rejected task stays rejected: it is final.

rejectedBy.description: Parent task only. Must be one of `canApprovedBy`.

parent.description: Root tasks have no parent; a subtask points to its parent task.

dependOn.description: List of tasks this task waits for; may be empty. For a subtask, the sibling subtasks named in the process.

process.description: Parent task only: the _process it follows. Null for a task without one and for subtasks.

canApprovedBy.description: Parent task only: the roles allowed to approve or reject it. Set by whoever creates the task. ["human"] when omitted, so no agent approves by default.

customInstructions.description: Parent task only: overrides of the default instructions of the process, as { subtask name: text }. Set when the task is created.

subtask.description: Subtask only: the name of its entry in the process.

instructions.description: Subtask only: the instructions of the subtask, from the process or overridden by `customInstructions` of the parent.
